node.description: Outcome-Governed Shared Memory System for Multi-Agent Fleets
FastAPI service, memory governance, vector search, and queue workers

node.implementation: Implements the FastAPI application. Exposes REST endpoints: /context (memory retrieval), /experiences (trajectory ingestion), /reuse (outcome reporting), /health (health probes), and /metrics (Prometheus export).

The algorithmic core of ActionCloud. Implements the 5-tier memory promotion ladder (PRIVATE -> AGENT -> SHARED -> VALIDATED -> ORGANIZATIONAL). Calculates Bayesian Beta-posterior confidence c(m) = (s + 1.2)/(n + 2). Enforces automatic quarantine upon consecutive failures or confidence dropping below threshold.

Queries PostgreSQL pgvector for candidate experiences matching incoming task descriptions. Filters candidates using relevance threshold tau and confidence floor c_min. Performs deduplication and injects top-1 procedure (k=1) to prevent context pollution.

Parses raw agent execution trajectories (prompts, tool calls, bash commands, outputs) and extracts structured knowledge: clean step-by-step procedures, required prerequisites, tools used, and failure pitfalls.
Generates 384-dimensional semantic dense vector embeddings from task descriptions and query strings for vector similarity matching in PostgreSQL pgvector.
Orchestrates trajectory intake: runs knowledge extraction, generates embeddings, assigns initial tier via Memory Judge, and executes idempotent relational and vector writes into PostgreSQL.

Async database connection pool using asyncpg and pgvector. Handles transactional operations, row-level locking (SELECT ... FOR UPDATE) during tier transitions to prevent race conditions, and logs injection-to-reuse audit trails.
Applies half-life exponential decay to memory confidence scores over elapsed epochs/time to ensure stale procedures naturally lose prominence unless continuously re-validated.
Defines cross-tier access control matrices. Governs which agent roles (Coding, DevOps, SRE, DB, Security) are authorized to view or elevate memories across each tier.
Validates incoming Bearer tokens using SHA-256 hashed database keys. Maps incoming requests to verified Agent IDs and security roles, preventing impersonation.
Asynchronously enqueues raw agent execution traces to Amazon SQS / LocalStack SQS so API request threads remain low-latency and decoupled from processing workloads.

Continuously polls Amazon SQS for new trajectory messages. Processes ingestion via pipeline.py, manages message acknowledgments, handles poison pill retries, and forwards repeated errors to the Dead-Letter Queue (DLQ).
Implements an MCP stdio server that exposes ActionCloud tools (search_memory, store_experience, report_outcome) directly to external IDE agents such as Cursor, Claude Desktop, and Antigravity.
Lightweight HTTP client providing clean methods for agents to interact with the ActionCloud API: fetch context, report reuse outcomes, and submit execution traces.
Defines Prometheus counters, gauges, and latency histograms for context retrieval latencies, memory reuse success rates, tier promotions, and quarantine counts.
Fetches database credentials and API master keys dynamically from AWS Secrets Manager using boto3 with local fallback to environment variables.
Defines strong type contracts for API requests/responses, memory objects, injection records, reuse feedback, and benchmark execution logs.
Loads and validates environment variables (DATABASE_URL, SQS_QUEUE_URL, AWS_REGION, confidence thresholds, embedding models) using pydantic-settings.

node.description: 12 distinct agent roles and fleet coordination

node.implementation: Defines 12 specialized agent roles (Frontend, Backend, DevOps, DB Admin, Security, SRE, QA, etc.) along with role-specific system prompts, allowed memory tiers, and execution constraints.
Abstract base class establishing the standard agent lifecycle: query memory context -> execute step -> verify outcome -> report outcome back to ActionCloud.
Orchestrates multi-agent workflows, dispatches tasks to appropriate agent personas based on capability match, and synchronizes shared memory context across cooperating agents.

node.description: 136 tasks across 45 families, dual-verifiers, and paired harness

node.implementation: Dataset of 136 benchmark tasks categorized across 45 parameterized families (DevOps, SQL migrations, API development, incident response, k8s debugging).
node.key_functions: Task definitions, inputs, expected ground truth criteria

node.implementation: Validated step-by-step procedures, tool arguments, and anti-patterns used by simulator or verifiers to assess memory quality.
Implements deterministic verification checking actual system state, return codes, regex patterns, and output invariants, avoiding lenient self-reporting bias.
Executes paired trial simulations across Baseline (no shared memory), Unchecked Shared Memory, and ActionCloud. Runs multi-epoch progressions across multiple random seeds.
Simulates agent problem solving with injected memory procedures, modeling error injection, recovery attempts, tool call latency, and token consumption.

node.description: Relational schema, pgvector extension, audit tables

node.implementation: Enables the vector extension. Creates experiences table (id, task, procedure, embedding, tier, confidence, success_count, failure_count) with IVFFlat/HNSW vector index.
node.key_functions: CREATE EXTENSION vector, CREATE TABLE experiences

node.implementation: Creates reuse_events table to log every memory injection, agent feedback, outcome verification, and execution timestamp.
Creates agents table storing agent identities, roles, and hashed API keys. Creates injections table to track which memory was injected into which run.
node.key_functions: CREATE TABLE agents, CREATE TABLE injections

node.implementation: Adds author reputation tracking and initial prior weighting to experience records based on historical author reliability.
node.key_functions: ALTER TABLE experiences ADD COLUMN author_reputation

node.implementation: Adds tenant_id, session_id, and TTL expiration timestamps to experiences for secure enterprise multi-tenancy and automatic cleanup.
node.key_functions: ALTER TABLE experiences ADD COLUMN expires_at

node.implementation: Creates llm_run_activity table logging live 6-stage lifecycle states (retrieve, act, verify, store, govern, done) for real-time dashboard display.

node.description: Reproducibility runners, ablation analysis, and chart generators

node.implementation: Executes the complete experimental suite (2,040 runs across 5 seeds and 3 epochs), evaluating baseline vs ActionCloud and saving raw JSON metrics.
Runs experiments varying k in [1, 2, 3, 5] to measure context token bloat, latency, and conflicting procedure confusion, proving optimality of k=1.
Simulates adversarial malicious agents attempting to inject toxic or incorrect procedures into shared memory to evaluate quarantine containment.
Sweeps similarity threshold tau from 0.50 to 0.95 to find the optimal operating point (tau=0.82) balancing recall against false retrieval.
Generates high-resolution IEEE publication charts (success rate progression, token savings, tier transitions, latency percentiles) using matplotlib.
Comprehensive health and functional verification testing API endpoints, database inserts, vector queries, SQS queue roundtrip, and governance promotion.
Applies SQL migration scripts sequentially to the target PostgreSQL database with idempotency checks.

node.description: Streamlit interactive visualization for live fleet runs and memory governance

node.implementation: Interactive real-time web dashboard. Renders live task stages (retrieve -> act -> verify -> store -> govern -> done), active agent IDs, token metrics, and memory tier breakdown.
Computes statistical summaries, error containment rates, cost/token savings curves, and generates visual charts for the dashboard UI.

node.description: AWS cloud resources and Kubernetes packaging

node.implementation: Provisions multi-AZ VPC, public/private subnets, NAT Gateways, Internet Gateways, and security groups ensuring private RDS and worker isolation.
Provisions AWS EKS Kubernetes cluster, EC2 managed node groups, Amazon RDS PostgreSQL 16 with pgvector, Amazon SQS FIFO/standard queues with DLQ, and IAM IRSA roles.
Kubernetes deployment specification for ActionCloud FastAPI containers with readiness/liveness HTTP probes and ClusterIP service.
Kubernetes deployment specification for background SQS queue consumers processing ingestion tasks.
Defines autoscaling policies scaling API pods automatically based on CPU and request concurrency thresholds.
Kubernetes pre-install / pre-upgrade Job that executes database migration scripts before rolling out new application pods.
Multi-stage Docker build producing a secure, lightweight Python 3.11 container artifact for both API and Worker workloads.
Orchestrates local services: ActionCloud API, Worker, PostgreSQL with pgvector, and LocalStack (SQS emulator).
Declares core dependencies: FastAPI, asyncpg, pgvector, pydantic, boto3, prometheus_client, and dev tools (pytest, ruff, mypy).
Visual diagram specification illustrating the interaction between agent fleets, API, SQS, PostgreSQL, and AWS cloud boundary.
